terms.definition: The spongy organs where the body takes in oxygen and lets out carbon dioxide.
terms.whereItIs: Inside the chest, protected by the ribcage.
terms.whyItMatters: They keep every cell supplied with oxygen.

terms.definition: Tiny air sacs at the end of the airways where gas exchange happens.
terms.function: Thin walls let oxygen and carbon dioxide cross.
terms.whereItIs: At the ends of the bronchioles.
terms.whyItMatters: They are where the actual oxygen pickup happens.

terms.definition: The two main branches of the windpipe leading into the lungs.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the entrance roads for air.

terms.definition: The small branching tubes that carry air to the alveoli.
terms.function: Route air deeper into the lung.
terms.whyItMatters: They deliver air to the exchange sacs.

terms.definition: The smooth membrane covering the lungs.
terms.function: Lets the lungs glide smoothly as they breathe.
terms.whereItIs: Around the outside of each lung.
